title: Apneic oxygenation with high-flow nasal oxygenation after preoxygenation with noninvasive ventilation before intubation in hypoxemic patients in intensive care unit. A multicenter randomized controlled trial.
official: Apneic oxygenation with high-flow nasal oxygenation after preoxygenation with noninvasive ventilation before intubation in hypoxemic patients in intensive care unit. A multicenter randomized controlled trial.
summary: Main objective: To assess whether apneic oxygenation with HFNO would decrease the incidence of severe hypoxemia compared to no apneic oxygenation during the intubation procedure (from the start of laryngoscopy to 5 minutes after successful intubation) in patients with hypoxemic acute respiratory failure.

interventions.name: OXYGENE MEDICINAL LIQUIDE AIR LIQUIDE SANTE FRANCE, gaz pour inhalation, pour évaporateur fixe

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient admitted in the ICU
2. Indication of orotracheal intubation
3. Hypoxemic acute respiratory failure defined by:      ○ One sign of acute respiratory distress (respiratory rate >25/min, dyspnea or the use of accessory respiratory muscle)      ○ AND a PaO2/FiO2 ≤ 200 mmHg (measured or calculated FiO2) within 24 hours before the decision of intubation. For the calculation of FiO2, the FiO2 will be estimated by: FiO2 = 0.21 + 0.03 x (flow of oxygen) (valid if O₂ flow rate ≥ 10 L/min with a high-concentration mask)
4. Informed consent from the patient or relatives. An emergency procedure will be possible when necessary.
Exclusion criteria:
1. < 18 years old
2. Need for emergent intubation (i.e. cardiac arrest)
3. Contraindication to non-invasive ventilation for preoxygenation
4. Known allergy or contraindication to one of the induction drugs
5. SpO2 device specific for the study not available
6. Patients without any healthcare insurance scheme or not benefiting from it through a third party
7. Persons under law protection, namely minors, pregnant or breastfeeding women, persons deprived of their liberty by a judicial or administrative decision.
8. Previous participation in the study
